tools.name: get_moon_phase
tools.description: Get the moon phase, illumination, moon sign and next full/new moon for any date (1900–2100). Optionally pass latitude/longitude to also get moonrise and moonset times (UTC).

tools.name: list_full_moons
tools.description: List every full moon of a year (1900–2100) with exact UTC times, traditional names and moon signs.

tools.name: list_new_moons
tools.description: List every new moon of a year (1900–2100) with exact UTC times and moon signs.
